Name: REVERB_AUX_SEND_BUS_PARAM_ST
Description:
Reverb types: the row ID is the reverb type set by SoundAutoReverbSelectParam, SoundCutsceneParam and the map default reverb. Sounds send fully to the current type's aux bus and not at all to the other rows' buses; emitters marked indoor or outdoor can use the buses named in SoundCommonSystemParam rows 100/101 instead. Only types 0-8 can be selected (higher types are ignored) and at most 16 rows are read. Read once at sound startup. Lives in systemparam.parambnd, not regulation.bin.
Retail: 0 none, 1 outdoor, 2 outdoor narrow, 3 room, 4 large room, 5 hall, 6 large hall, 7 underground tunnel/cave, 8 large underground space.

Fields.Name: Reverb Aux Send Bus Name
Fields.Description: Name of the Wwise auxiliary (reverb) bus for this reverb type, e.g. _003_Room. Must match a bus in the sound banks. SoundCommonSystemParam rows 100/101 refer to these names.
